name: Signals and Schedules
description: Signals keep trains from hitting each other.

pages.title: Signals and Schedules
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A **Train Signal** splits track into segments, each holding one train at a time.
- Signals only govern trains nobody is driving.
- A **Train Schedule** lists stops and when to leave each. Hand it to a seated driver.
Signals keep trains from hitting each other. A Train Signal splits the track into segments, and each segment holds **one train at a time**. Signals only govern trains that **nobody is driving**.

pages.title: Train Signal
pages.text: Placed beside a track like a station. A scheduled train never crosses one against its direction unless a second signal faces that way.

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: A redstone signal forces a Train Signal red, and a red signal gives a comparator output. [#](2E5AAC)[Nixie Tubes](entry://create_basics/redstone_and_control)[#]() attached to a signal make the lights easier to read from a distance.

pages.title: Train Observer
pages.text: Select a track, place the observer nearby. It fires when a train crosses the marker and can be filtered by cargo.

pages.title: Schedules
pages.text:
A **Train Schedule** holds a list of stops and the conditions to leave each.

- Right-click it to edit, then give it to a driver.
- Any mob, or a [#](2E5AAC)[Blaze Burner](entry://create_basics/heat)[#](), seated in front of [#](2E5AAC)[Train Controls](entry://transport/trains)[#]() counts as a conductor.
- You can take the schedule back at any time.

pages.title: Train Schedule
pages.text: Stations are the stops. Conditions can be a delay, a cargo level, a redstone signal and more.

pages.title: Two modes
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** A [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() switches a signal to its second mode. A brass-mode signal is meant to lead into ordinary ones: it holds a train back if, once inside, it could not leave the next segment at once. That keeps queued trains out of a busy junction.

pages.title: Going further
pages.text: Steam 'n' Rails adds track switches and semaphores, and Railways Navigator adds route planning and penalty anchors that make trains avoid stretches of track. See [#](2E5AAC)[Train Add-ons](entry://transport/train_addons)[#]().
